operations.read: look up records without changing them
operations.export: copy data out of the system, e.g. a CSV download
operations.archive: hide records from normal use without deleting them; can be undone
operations.delete: permanently remove records; cannot be undone
operations.send: send a message to people (email or chat)
operations.invite: invite people to an event, channel or account
operations.share: give someone access to a file or record

evidence.days_since_login: number: days since anyone at the customer logged in

evidence.days_since_updated: number: days since the contact record changed

evidence.days_since_activity: number: days since the deal last had any activity
evidence.account_status: the customer's status: active, churned or prospect

evidence.created_by: who or what created the lead, e.g. qa-script

evidence.days_overdue: number: days past the due date

evidence.days_waiting: number: days since the last reply

resources.support.macros: saved reply templates for support agents

evidence.days_old: number: age of the message in days
number: days since the draft was last edited
evidence.owner: email address of the person who owns the draft

evidence.days_since_opened: number: days since anyone opened the report

evidence.days_since_viewed: number: days since anyone viewed the dashboard
